div.div: قَرَبٌ حَذْحَاذٌ (assumed tropical:) A quick [night-journey to water]; (S, L, K;) like حَثْحَاثٌ: (S, A, L:) and farextending, or distant; as also ↓ حُذَاحِذٌ . (L.) And خِمْسٌ حَذْحَاذٌ (L) and ↓ أَحَذُّ (K) [A journey of five days whereof the second and third and fourth are without water] in which is no languor, or flagging; (L;) and quick. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
